items.title: Compute the actual signed Gaussian test expectation

source.anchor: Appendix B.2.2: Gaussian density p_O, bounded test h_lambda, H definition Ex56, Ex58/Ex59/Fubini, Ex60 and Eq21; Eq4/Eq26 providers. Conditioned-mixture Ex57/Eq20 remains separate.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. Actual law-to-density expectation transport and all required L1 conditions are explicit elaborations of the density-based source calculation.

items.statement: Let n>=3, kappa>=4 and ell>=0, including zero. For every full real orthogonal O put A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O transpose), gamma_O the actual canonical Gaussian N(0,A_O inverse), p_O(x)=sqrt(det A_O)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A_O x/2) on actual Euclidean volume, and t(x)=exp(-ell||x||_2^2). For every O, t is absolutely L1 under gamma_O, t*p_O is absolutely L1 under Euclidean volume, and their integrals agree. The signed expectation O -> det(O) integral t d gamma_O is absolutely L1 under the actual normalized full O(n) Haar probability. Its Haar average equals (-1)^(n-1)(sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1)/2^(n/2) times the Haar average of ((sqrt(kappa)+1)U-(sqrt(kappa)-1))/(kappa+1+4ell-(kappa-1)U)^(n/2), where U=O_11. All dimension-half powers use real division. None of the L1, density or transport conclusions is a caller hypothesis. This identifies the actual signed Gaussian test expectation, without constructing determinant-conditioned target mixtures or proving their relation to TV.
assumptions: Exactly n>=3, kappa>=4 and ell>=0 including ell=0.

Existing literal precision, actual canonical Gaussian covariance A_O inverse, canonical Euclidean volume and actual full orthogonal Haar probability, with both determinant signs. The norm is the true Euclidean norm and WithLp.ofLp supplies coordinates.

Gaussian test L1, weighted-volume L1, density nonnegativity/measurability, law-to-density integral equality and signed outer Haar L1 are proved internally. No caller probability-density or integrability premise.

Determinant-conditioned target-mixture construction/half-mass, Ex57/Eq20 H-to-TV, sphere/Poisson, parameter choice, amplification/transcript/eigenbasis and both main lower bounds remain open.
